deficiencies.rule: C. An administrator shall ensure that: 5. Unless otherwise stated: a. Documentation required by this Article is provided to the Department within two hours after a Department request; and
deficiencies.evidence: Based on observation and interview, the administrator failed to ensure documentation required by Article 7 was provided to the Department within two hours after a Department request. The deficient practice posed a risk as the Department was unable to determine substantial compliance. Findings include: R9-10-720.C.3. An administrator shall maintain documentation of a current fire inspection. 1. The Compliance Officer requested to review the facility's current fire inspection. However, a current fire inspection report was not provided for review within two hours after a Department request. 2. In an interview, E1 reported the facility had a current fire inspection and E1 reported to be unable to locate the documentation. E1 acknowledged a current fire inspection report was not provided for review within two hours after a Department request.
